streaming_prefix_v3_regression.conclusion: The cached V3 survived a true append/query streaming regime in the tested cases: every append invalidated the root cache, repeated same-m queries hit cache without extra root-stat work, and V2 decisions were preserved.

planned_slot_interrupt_monitor.contract: Freeze slot identities, planned size, B_cap and deadline before outcomes. Canonical results by deadline contribute score in [0,1]; every absent/failed slot becomes 1 at fail-closed close; late retry cannot overwrite the planned-slot failure; predictable weight is planned_size/B_cap.
planned_slot_interrupt_monitor.conclusion: Durable pre-admission plus recovery-after-deadline prevents outage/deadline slots from disappearing from the denominator.

ope_target_boundary.matched_special_case: When target policy equals logging policy, importance ratios are exactly 1 and unit-weight IPS/OPE and the ordinary average-conditional-mean estimator are pathwise identical.
ope_target_boundary.wrong_target_counterexample: With Y~Bernoulli(.05) but realized completed count N=10 for Y=1 and N=100 for Y=0, using N as a current-outcome-dependent weight changes the equal-process target .05 to about .005236 analytically; 200k simulation gave .049875 versus .005222.
ope_target_boundary.rule: OPE counterfactual policy-value and predictable observed-reliability weighting are distinct contracts except in explicitly matched special cases.

joint_process_exposure_gate.result: For the single conjunctive decision that BOTH equal-process and planned-exposure unreliability are below their tolerances, no alpha split is required: if each unsafe-null e-process is valid on the common filtration, require both component e-values >=1/alpha. Equivalently min(E_process,E_exposure) is a stopped e-value for the union null. At alpha=.05 the component threshold is 20, not 40 as in a .025/.025 Bonferroni split.
joint_process_exposure_gate.scope: This is an intersection-union decision guarantee, not 95% simultaneous numerical coverage of two separately reported confidence sequences.

Public serving traces demonstrate different layers of nondeterminism; none yet provides the preferred same-fingerprint raw-output plus deterministic-score propagation dataset.

measurement_validity_rules: A cache optimization is computational only unless the statistical contract changes; validate append invalidation, residual fail-closed behavior and decision agreement separately.

Infrastructure no-result must not silently disappear from a pre-admitted denominator. Missing-as-one targets composite actual-policy unreliability unless a coherent latent forced-completion outcome is explicitly assumed.
Off-policy value and predictable reliability weighting are distinct estimands; compare methods numerically only after proving target identity.
Outcome-dependent realized completed count is not a predictable planned-exposure weight.
Two marginal 95% bounds do not imply 95% joint coverage, but a single AND safety decision can use the intersection-union rule at alpha without Bonferroni splitting.
Do not infer token, score or paired-sign divergence from byte/logprob divergence without measuring the downstream layer.
scope_guards: All new simulation/timing/count results are local or synthetic and are not production measurements.
The streaming regression validates V3 against V2 numerically; it does not independently prove the predecessor mathematical derivation.
The fail-closed monitor validates state-machine/endpoint semantics; outer confidence-sequence validity is separate.
The OPE matched case is deliberately target=logging and should not be generalized to nontrivial off-policy settings.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read, no shared ledger was read, and no connector-discovery mutation was performed.
